color.note: Ink & Signal: neutral by default, color means change. Semantic tokens first, then the Slate, Rust and Cobalt ramps they draw from.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Paper. App and page background behind cards and tables.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, zebra rows, code blocks and the segmented-control track; sits inside `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and tooltips, always with `shadow-md`.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse bands (marketing footer, onboarding banner); text on it is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: table rules, card outlines, dividers. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control outlines (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes); at least 3:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, secondary table columns, inactive tabs. At least 6:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders, axis labels and timestamps; at least 4.5:1 on every surface. 12px minimum.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast); never for information.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The Ink button: primary action fill, at most one per view.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Clarity cobalt: links (always underlined), selected states, active navigation, and the 'decrease' direction. Text-safe on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover and pressed selected state.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item and info-notice background; text on it stays `ink` or `accent`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour, drawn by the `focus-ring` shadow; at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Signal rust, the one change: the logo segment, the drifted tick, change marks, flags and 'increase' marks in charts. Graphics only (3.5:1 on `bg` light, 5.1:1 dark); never body text.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Signal as text: increase amounts and 'Changed' labels on `surface`, `bg` and `signal-soft`.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a changed or flagged cell and the signal badge.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `signal` fill. Ink, never white (white on rust is 3.7:1).

tokens.name: delta-up
tokens.usage: Chart mark for an increase against the previous period.

tokens.name: delta-up-ink
tokens.usage: Increase amounts as text, always with the up arrow and the sign.

tokens.name: delta-down
tokens.usage: Chart mark for a decrease against the previous period.

tokens.name: delta-down-ink
tokens.usage: Decrease amounts as text, always with the down arrow and the minus sign.

tokens.name: delta-flat
tokens.usage: Unchanged marks: the baseline ticks of the drift strip and zero-change bars. Decorative; the value is always labelled.

tokens.name: chart-previous
tokens.usage: The previous period's bar or line when two payroll periods are compared (4.2:1 on `surface` in both themes).

tokens.name: chart-current
tokens.usage: The current period's bar or line, beside `chart-previous`.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1 (e.g. Base salary). Slots are assigned in order 1 to 6, never cycled; a 7th category folds into Other.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 (green). The six-slot order passes adjacent colour-blind separation in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon and mark fill (Reconciled, Upload complete); always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon fill (Unmapped column, Missing period); its label is `on-warning` or sits beside it in `warning-ink`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill and error icon. Crimson, kept well apart from `signal` rust: a change is not an error.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on `surface`, `bg` and `danger-soft`; error messages start with the icon.

tokens.name: slate-900
tokens.usage: Ramp. Ink: brand core colour, light `ink` and `primary`, dark `surface`.

tokens.name: rust-100
tokens.usage: Ramp. Highlight behind a flagged table row.

tokens.name: rust-500
tokens.usage: Ramp. Signal: brand core colour, the logo segment.

tokens.name: cobalt-500
tokens.usage: Ramp. Clarity: brand core colour, light `accent`.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Instrument Sans 600 with tight tracking. Marketing and page heroes only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero headline; one per page.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Every payroll run, compared line by line

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Sentence case everywhere. Body never below 14px; nothing below 12px.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Table group headers, form sections, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 312 employees were paid in both periods; 14 changed by more than 5%.
styles.usage: Default UI and reading text; keep lines under 75 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI: table text, menus, helper text.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and segmented-control labels (13px on small buttons).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, column headers, stat labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, badges, chart axes; the smallest size in the system.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Numbers never jump: Geist Mono in tables, tabular Instrument Sans for hero figures.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Hero figures on stat cards, with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Amounts, percentages and deltas in tables; right-aligned.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Pay codes, employee IDs, column keys and code.

spacing.note: 4px base. Dense data UI uses steps 1 to 4; layout uses 6 and up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside badges and variance chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input side padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing hero top and bottom padding.

radius.note: Precise, not pill-shaped: small radii, square signal marks.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Drift-strip ticks, progress bars, chart bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, notices, the segmented-control track.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, marketing panels, the app icon at small sizes.

size.note: Control heights. Desktop data UI defaults to 40px; touch layouts use 48px.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs inside tables and toolbars.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, badges and table cells.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Nothing clickable is smaller in either direction (WCAG 2.2 target size).

shadow.note: Borders first, shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Selected segmented-control thumb, sticky table header.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then 2px of `focus`. The two hexes per theme are that theme's `surface`/`bg` and `focus`; change them together.
